label: Loading state
purpose: Hold the frame while the model has nothing to show yet, and hint at the shape of the answer coming.
when_to_use: The gap before the first token when no reasoning step can be named.
when_not_to_use: Once a step is known (ThinkingIndicator) or once tokens stream (StreamingText).
composition: A grayscale pixel matrix that keeps time
DLS Skeleton lines standing in for the answer shape
responsive: Caps at a readable max width; matrix and skeleton stack.
accessibility: role=status + aria-live=polite + an aria-label naming what is loading
the matrix and skeleton are aria-hidden decoration
anti_patterns: a bare spinner with no hint of the answer shape
a skeleton whose layout does not resemble the content it precedes
assumptions: The label is a DEMO value — name what is actually loading.
Skeleton line widths are placeholders — match them to the expected answer shape.

references.note: assistant-ui's Elements catalogue (https://www.assistant-ui.com/elements, checked 2026-08) is the CONCEPTUAL reference; no code is copied. Composed from the real DLS Skeleton primitive plus a token-only pixel matrix.
